description: List ASX company announcements for a listed Australian company by ticker: date and time (Sydney), headline, price-sensitive flag, page count, file size, a derived category (share_issue, unquoted_securities, cessation_of_securities, buyback, director_interest, substantial_holder, trading_halt, quarterly_cashflow, results, meeting, other) and a document link. Newest first. Source: ASX company announcements. Use asx_get_share_issues for dilution questions.

months.description: Look-back window in months (default 6). Ignored when year is given.

year.description: Full calendar year instead of a rolling window, e.g. 2025

name: asx_get_announcements
title: Asx Get Announcements
